desc: The relay's diet, two players each in their own game at real speed (60 frames a second): standing in the same room, walking (the guest's ghost of the host interpolated), a shared battle. Each game sends the relay at most 800 messages a minute of play (0.5.0: 1,200 each, every 3 frames), nothing sent twice while linked, the same progress

log_must: net: relay messages: \d+ in all over \d+ frames
